title: The Year Without a Summer
description: 1816 is known as the Year Without a Summer. Severe climate abnormalities caused crop failures and food shortages across the Northern Hemisphere. Evidence suggests it was mainly a volcanic winter caused by the April 1815 eruption of Mount Tambora in the Dutch East Indies, modern Indonesia. Source: Wikipedia, Year Without a Summer.
